answer: A product-grade surface for the catalog floors (96 workflows + 64 presets) requires 992 user-facing strings, 162 help topics, and 160 examples. String counts are schema-slot counts on the live [REDACTED] typed registry (7 slots per workflow_blueprint, 5 slots per council_preset) multiplied by the 96/64 floors in the unit question — not a per-item guess and not a claim that 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.json or 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json exist here (they do not). The live registry holds 1 workflow and 1 preset entries; those records populate the counted slots. Recursive, iterative, and required-only walks agreed (992). A skip-$ref walk differed (10 paths), so the $ref on `id` is not silent. Today's doc-versus-code sample on existing commands is 21/23 (rate=0.9130); git history rate is NOT-CHECKED. If help topics, examples, catalog indexes and discovery names stay hand-maintained, expected stale strings per release is 905.7391 on this rate. If those classes are GENERATED from the typed registry and a regenerate+byte-compare check gates the release, expected stale after the check is 0.0. Must-generate: workflow/preset catalogs, help pages, examples, discovery name lists. May hand-maintain: the three-part error-message contract prose and the product surface names (one command, one cockpit, one catalog).

derivation.method: Count JSON Schema string (and string-const) slots under definitions.workflow_blueprint and definitions.council_preset on the live [REDACTED] registry schema, resolving $ref; multiply by question floors 96 and 64. Help topics = 96+64+2 catalog indexes. Examples = 96+64. Re-count with an iterative stack walk. If the two counts disagree, BLOCKED with both numbers.
